findings.evidence: Both proofs are `rfl`-level on the same `def HasValenceNumbers ... := ∀ i Q2, PDF.valenceNumber f i Q2 = (M.valenceNumber i : ℝ)` (line 96). The in-repo convention for a `Prop` def is a single unfolding lemma: `PseudoscalarMeson.isChargeConsistent_iff` (Meson/Basic.lean:271) and `Fragmentation.momentumSumRule_iff` (Fragmentation/MomentumSumRule.lean:83) each stand alone, with no companion accessor.
findings.fix: Keep `hasValenceNumbers_iff` (the complete iff, also used by `hasValenceNumbers_chargeConj_iff`) and delete `HasValenceNumbers.valenceNumber_eq`, replacing its in-file uses (`hf.valenceNumber_eq i Q2`) by `hf i Q2`.
findings.issue: `HasValenceNumbers.valenceNumber_eq` (103-105, proof `h i Q2`) and `hasValenceNumbers_iff` (108-110, proof `Iff.rfl`) are two public names for the same definitional unfolding of `HasValenceNumbers`: the former is `hasValenceNumbers_iff.mp h i Q2`.

summary: The PR reuses the upstream valence/charge-conjugation/model API correctly and adds genuinely new material, but it proves the same constant-pull-out identity twice inside the diff and ships two definitionally identical unfolding lemmas for `HasValenceNumbers`.
